data.text:
OFFICIAL STATEMENT FROM TEAM AZVER OFFICIAL

We have been receiving an overwhelming number of messages regarding ticket availability for the upcoming Big Night. First and foremost, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has shown interest and eagerness to join us for this highly anticipated event. It truly means so much to see such a strong outpouring of support for AZ and River.

However, we regret to inform you that due to the very limited ticket allocation provided to our team, all tickets have already been fully distributed. A total of three (3) tickets were allotted to our core admins, while the remaining tickets were given to members of the community—some of whom made significant efforts to travel all the way to Manila—and a few were reserved for our sponsors, whose continued support has helped us move forward in many ways.

Please know that we truly did our best to secure and provide more tickets for the community. Unfortunately, due to the venue’s capacity and the constraints of the allocation system, we were unable to obtain additional tickets beyond what was initially given to us.

We understand how disappointing this news may be for many of you. Know that this decision—and even more so, this announcement—was not made lightly. As a team, we exhausted all possible options before arriving at this point, and we genuinely wish we could have accommodated everyone who wanted to be there.

That said, we want to make sure no one feels left behind during this special occasion. To that end, we will be opening a Group Direct Message (GDM) dedicated to Team Labas—AzVer supporters who may not be inside the New Frontier Theater but still wish to take part and rally for AzVer right outside the venue. This space will allow us to coordinate, connect, and show our unified support in real time. If you are interested in joining the GDM, kindly reply to this tweet and our team will reach out to include you.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support, patience, and understanding. As we approach the Big Night, let us continue to stand together—united in our love and pride for AZ and River. Let’s make these final moments count and give them the support they truly deserve. 💚🍀
